headline: Solid annual growth cools on a sequential basis
summary_short: Visa's fiscal Q2 2026 revenue climbed to $11.63B (+14.4% y/y) and diluted EPS reached $2.97 (+10.4% y/y), but momentum cooled sequentially with EPS down 5.4% q/q and net income of $5.63B down 6.5% q/q.
summary_long: Revenue of $11.63B rose 14.4% y/y and 3.6% q/q. Operating income of $7.13B rose 15.4% y/y but slipped 1.4% q/q as operating margin eased to 61.3% from 64.4% q/q. Gross profit of $8.90B gained 8.5% y/y, down 2.6% q/q. EBIT ($7.03B, +10.3% y/y) and EBITDA ($7.39B, +10.5% y/y) each declined roughly 4% q/q. Net income of $5.63B rose 6.8% y/y but fell 6.5% q/q. Diluted EPS of $2.97 gained 10.4% y/y, down 5.4% q/q. No filing was read this run; balance-sheet detail and guidance are not assessed.
